Launch tags:Open Source•Developer Tools•Artificial Intelligence [...] Hey Product Hunters! 🖐️ I'm Dee, Head of AI & Robotics at Autonomous. We're excited to launch Harness on Product Hunt today and show you what we built. We run a lot of coding agents. Claude Code at work, Codex at home, Hermes in the cloud. One thing bothered us: every agent sits in its own window on its own machine, stops to ask something, and just waits. We decided to change this. What if all of them lived in one command center? 🖥️ Every agent, every machine, side by side in a native app for Mac and Linux 🌿 Each agent on its own branch. Close the app and your agents keep working 🔒 End-to-end encrypted. Free and open source 🧠 Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Pi, Hermes and more 📱 Answer your agents on the go with the Harness app, available now on both the Apple App Store [...] I was confused at first but I extracted this "onboarding" from the main page without adding the harness and my agent almost bought a key (cute)

@christianruink  Thanks, Christian, and sorry for the confusion. That's on us, not you. Love that your agent almost bought a key though 😄.

Quick version:

 Harness runs the agents you already have, with your own accounts. So install the agent CLI first (Claude Code, Codex…).
 ⌘N, pick your agent and a folder, type the task, hit New Harness.
 The pane opens with that agent running. If it isn't signed in yet, it shows the agent's own login right there.

Sign in once and you're set.

Where did it first feel confusing? We're fixing onboarding this week and your answer helps a lot.
